list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned; 0 online trophies.
listSources: Exophase — GTA VI trophies (official names, descriptions, grades): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi
note: Every guide below is written in our own words for this entry. Names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Where no published guide pins down a step or location, the guide says so instead of inventing it.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap stages in order (story, strangers, activities, collectibles, crime and money, then the 100% cleanup) and this is the last trophy you will earn. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours, so the grind is time, not skill. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (platinum, difficulty and time estimate); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically: finish the first main mission of Chapter 1, 'Gone Fishing'. It cannot be missed — just play the story from the start. PowerPyx lists it as an automatic story trophy that unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish every main mission of Chapter 1. Do the one thing that matters in this chapter first: the missable meditation — after the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to meditate (PowerPyx). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since the game has no mission replay. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish every main mission of Chapter 2. This is the chapter where both Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the partner trophies (losing a 4-star wanted level together, robbing shops together). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (both protagonists playable from Chapter 2); OutputLag trophy list (Chapter 2 opens partner play); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish every main mission of Chapter 3. The robbery trophies (bank vaults, armored trucks, illegal operations) open up in Chapters 3 and 4, so start those while you play through rather than leaving them all for after the story. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter. Source: OutputLag trophy list (robbery trophies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish every main mission of Chapter 4. By now the whole map of Leonida and the late-game robbery content should be open; finish any stranger mission strands that are available before the finale, since some optional missions disappear as the story advances (PowerPyx notes this does not lock any trophy, because there are far more optional missions than the game needs). Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter and another before the final mission. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the final mission. Keep a manual save before the finale — PowerPyx advises a save before the final mission because the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so a separate save is your only way back. After the credits the 100% completion checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and free-roam cleanup begins. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; OutputLag trophy list (no mission replay, no New Game Plus); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'Breakfast Run'. It cannot be missed — it unlocks by playing the story in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'The Cartel Heist'. It cannot be missed — it unlocks by playing the story in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'Child's Play'. It cannot be missed — it unlocks by playing the story in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'Headliners'. It cannot be missed — it unlocks by playing the story in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'VCIA Takedown' at Vice City International Airport. It cannot be missed. The airport is also where the free-roam trophy 'Catch Me If You Can' (an unscheduled departure at VCIA) takes place, so that one is worth trying while you are here — but its exact method is still unconfirmed in published guides. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, earned automatically when you finish the main mission 'Operation Savage Glory'. It cannot be missed — it unlocks by playing the story in order. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for story trophies being automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players will earn before the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx says the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion — and ComingSoon reports the checklist needs scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, studying 100 of the 255 animals, and 70 of the 80 shooting-range and racing challenges. Nothing toward 100% is missable and everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Do it last, after the story, strangers, activities and collectibles are done. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; ComingSoon (200-hour platinum report); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps and unique stunts, which the game tracks as you drive, jump and fly. This is a pure grind best done alongside everything else: hit ramps and jumps whenever you travel instead of saving all 250 for the end. PowerPyx lists it among the longest grinds in the set, next to 100% completion and the 100 WAiNK locations. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Play one round of every activity type on the map — racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation and the rest. You do not need to win or finish well; trying each once is enough. Do it early, while you are already visiting those places for other trophies, and check the map for activity icons you have not touched yet. No published guide lists the exact activity count yet, so if one type will not register, try each variant of it (for example, both race types) rather than assuming the game is bugged. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the activity list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge (PSN tracks 42 challenges; the 100% checklist needs 70 of the 80 shooting-range and racing challenges combined, per ComingSoon). Go for golds with the weapons you shoot best, and use the range's own practice runs to learn each challenge's targets before a scored attempt. This is a skill trophy, not a grind — expect several tries on the hardest challenges. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; ComingSoon (70 of 80 challenges for 100%); Exophase and PSNProfiles for the official name, description, grade and PSN's challenge count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around Leonida. Learn one track at a time — the drone handles like a vehicle, so cut corners where the course allows and keep your speed through the gates. The exact number of locations is not pinned down in a published guide yet, so work through every Top Fun icon on the map and check the trophy only pops after the last one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the activity.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race icons across the map (street, off-road and any other race types the map shows) and tick each one off as you win it. Races also feed the 100% checklist, which needs 70 of the 80 shooting-range and racing challenges combined (ComingSoon), so winning races now saves cleanup later. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; ComingSoon (racing challenges count toward 100%); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — a head-to-head fishing contest, not just catching a fish. Find Cal at a fishing spot (the challenge is offered through the fishing activity), then out-fish him in the timed challenge. If the challenge does not appear, fish at other spots first: the challenge unlocks through the fishing activity itself. No published guide gives Cal's exact spot yet, so this guide does not invent one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the fishing activity.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Walk up to a cabinet, start a game and play it to its end (or its game-over screen, if the cabinet counts a completed run that way). This is one of the easiest trophies in the set — do it the first time you pass an arcade. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the activity list.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger-mission trophy: finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger missions appear as question-mark icons on the map; work through Andy's strand whenever it appears rather than leaving it for after the story. PowerPyx notes some optional missions disappear after a while, but that does not lock any trophy — there are far more optional missions than the game needs. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (optional missions and stranger strands).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger-mission trophy: finish Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Kenton's question-mark icons on the map and complete each mission in his strand as it opens. If a strand mission seems to vanish, do not panic — PowerPyx reports optional missions can disappear over time without locking any trophy. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger-mission trophy: finish Billy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Work through Billy's question-mark missions as they appear on the map, in the order the game offers them. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger mission strands).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida — the five named ones (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) plus three more stranger strands you find on the map. This is the silver that ties the stranger content together: keep taking question-mark missions whenever they appear, and do not leave them all for after the story, since some optional missions disappear as the story advances (PowerPyx says there are 200–300+ optional missions, far more than needed, so a vanished one never blocks this). Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (optional mission counts).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger-mission trophy: finish Randy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Randy's question-mark icons and complete each mission in order as the game offers them. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger mission strands).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger-mission trophy: finish Tyrone's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Tyrone's question-mark icons and complete each mission in order as the game offers them. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (stranger mission strands).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE one potentially missable trophy in the set (PowerPyx + GTABase). The first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — is reported to disappear after Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida. PowerPyx counts 18 spots across 10 locations, and meditating with both Lucia and Jason at one spot counts as +2 meditations there — so visit each spot with both characters. THE MISSABLE WARNING: after the Chapter 1 mission 'Down to Earth', talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, follows to the balcony, and you must choose 'Accept'. That first meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy, so doing it is the safe choice. Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (the missable meditation, 18 spots, 10 locations, +2 per spot); GTABase via eGamers (also flags it as the only possibly missable trophy).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt one unique animal for Bret — a named target animal, not a random one. Find Bret's hunting strand (a stranger mission), follow his lead to the unique animal's area, and take it down with a clean shot. Hunting also feeds the 100% checklist, which needs studying 100 of the 255 animals (ComingSoon), so study animals with the camera/binoculars whenever you hunt. No published guide gives the unique animal's location yet, so this guide does not invent one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; ComingSoon (100 of 255 animals for 100%); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards — find the cards scattered around Leonida and finish three whole sets. Cards are a pure collectible grind: sweep each region methodically and use the in-game progress menu to see which sets are still missing cards. No published card map exists yet at launch, so do not trust any single fan map until it is cross-checked — work region by region and let the game's own counter be the truth. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for collectibles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is one of the three longest grinds in the set (PowerPyx names it beside 100% completion and the 250 stunts). Do it as you travel: whenever you arrive somewhere new, WAiNK it before you leave, and keep a running mental map of the regions you have covered so the last 10 are not a blind sweep. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (one of the longest grinds); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's own challenge list (driving, shooting, exploration and other feats the progress menu tracks). Pick the easy ones first and let the count build naturally while you chase the other trophies; by the time the story, races and shooting-range work are done, you will be well on your way. Check the progress menu to see which challenges are closest to done. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the challenge system.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner (Jason and Lucia together) beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it in open country where you can outrun the search: get the stars up, break line of sight, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. It needs both protagonists together, so it only opens once both are playable in Chapter 2 (OutputLag). If it fails, just try again — there is no limit on attempts. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; OutputLag trophy list (both playable from Chapter 2); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level between them — the trick is to keep the heat, not lose it. Pick three shops close together on a quiet stretch of road, rob each quickly, and drive straight to the next without stopping to hide. If the wanted level drops to zero, the chain breaks and you start over. It needs both protagonists together (Chapter 2 onward). Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; OutputLag trophy list (both playable from Chapter 2); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or scan new models as you find them around Leonida. This overlaps heavily with the 100% checklist, which needs scanning 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles (ComingSoon), so scan every new vehicle you see from the start and this trophy will fall out of the 100% work. Cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all count toward the vehicle total. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; ComingSoon (200 of 277 vehicles for 100%); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode), take down 5 enemies. Set it up where enemies cluster: enter a firefight with a group close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain headshots before the meter runs out. Use a fast, accurate weapon and do not waste the slow-motion time on one target. Retry freely if you only get 3 or 4 — the trophy just needs one clean run of 5. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — get a plane off the ground at VCIA outside of a mission. The exact method is still unconfirmed in published guides (PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide will not invent a step: try stealing a parked plane on the runway and taking off, and if the trophy does not pop, wait for a confirmed method from PowerPyx or GTABase rather than repeating a guess. It is not flagged missable — nothing in the description ties it to a one-time moment. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A Rhino tank trophy — the description is a joke about the heat inside a tank, so the unlock involves driving or fighting in a Rhino. The exact trigger is not pinned down in any published guide yet (no confirmed method at launch), so this guide says so plainly instead of inventing a step: get into a Rhino tank (military base or a mission that provides one) and use it in combat, and check community guides once a confirmed method is published. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, quiet robbery. Go in masked, move slowly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, but you can retry as many times as you like — nothing about this trophy is one-time-only. Plan the exit before you enter. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies open in Chapters 3 and 4 (OutputLag), so start them while you play the story and finish the fifth in free-roam. For each vault: get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and escape the wanted level before the next one — the trophy counts completed escapes, not attempts. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; OutputLag trophy list (robbery trophies unlock in Chapters 3 and 4); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it (ram it or block it), take the cash from the back and lose the wanted level. One clean robbery and escape is all it takes, and you can retry as often as you like. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida — the trophy pops once you have visited all of the map's areas. Drive, fly and sail through each region rather than fast-travelling everywhere; the map's fog or region list in the progress menu shows what is still unexplored. Do it alongside the WAiNK, vehicle-scanning and meditation work so one sweep of the map covers four trophies at once. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the Leonida map and exploration.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operation (stash houses, drug labs and similar gang sites), rob it and escape. Keep a list of which gangs you have hit — the trophy needs one per gang, not several from the same gang. The gangs' operations are found by exploring and through story contacts; no published guide lists every gang's operation location yet. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — sit down for a drink at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and take in the view. The exact bar and trigger are not confirmed in any published guide yet (PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide will not invent a location: walk the Ocean Beach barfront, sit at a beach bar and order a cocktail, and check PowerPyx once a confirmed spot is published. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom's front window, the way the series' famous showroom scene goes. The exact showroom is not confirmed in any published guide yet (PowerPyx lists this among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide will not invent one: find a car showroom with a big glass front, drive in, then drive straight back out through the glass. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there and finish it. Bowling is one of the map's activities; walk into the alley, start a game and play it to the end. The 'follow-through' wording suggests finishing the game (or a full follow-through on a throw) rather than just starting one, so play the whole game. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap for the activity list.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership trophy — the vague description ('a partnership with mass appeal') gives no concrete step, and no published guide confirms the unlock method yet. The likeliest reading is a partner activity done well with Jason and Lucia together (both playable from Chapter 2), but that is a guess, not a fact, and this guide will not present it as one. Check PowerPyx or GTABase for a confirmed method before spending time on it. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; OutputLag trophy list (both playable from Chapter 2).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A choices trophy, tied to the Criminal Profile system. GTABase reports it needs 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the running record of how you play (violent or restrained) that changes how police treat you. Play normally and let the count build; do not go on a rampage just for this, because PowerPyx and GTABase both warn the 'Irredeemable' profile is permanent and makes police far more aggressive. The 500-action figure comes from a single source (GTABase via eGamers), so treat the number as reported, not confirmed. Source: GTABase via eGamers (500 Criminal Profile actions, single source); PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (Irredeemable is permanent); Exophase for the official name, description and grade.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something — most likely failing something once and then passing it on the retry. No published guide confirms the exact trigger yet (PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide will not invent one: if it does not pop naturally while you play, wait for a confirmed method from PowerPyx or GTABase. It is not flagged missable — the wording points at a retry, which implies it can be done again. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A mystery trophy — the description ('What the hell just happened?') points at a strange random event or secret encounter in Leonida, the series' usual UFO-and-weirdness territory. No published guide confirms the trigger yet (PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide will not invent a location or a step: explore odd places and random events in free-roam and check PowerPyx or GTABase once a confirmed method is published. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl pedestrians over with a melee drive-by — hit people with a melee weapon (a bat or similar) while driving past them in a vehicle. The exact count and trigger are not confirmed in any published guide yet (PowerPyx lists it among the trophies with no confirmed unlock method at launch), so this guide gives the plain reading of the description and nothing more: swing a melee weapon from a moving car at people on the street. Note that this feeds your Criminal Profile, so do it away from police and keep it brief. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx via eGamers (method not yet known at launch).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — Marked Bills are dirty cash earned from robberies, and your contacts clean it for a cut. Keep robbing (vaults, trucks, shops) to build up Marked Bills, then launder them through contacts whenever the option appears; the trophy counts the total laundered, so it builds up over the whole game. This pairs naturally with the robbery trophies in stage 5. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. It counts cumulatively across the whole game, so just buy gear, ammo and outfits as you play and it will pop on its own. If you are close at the end, buy expensive items (weapons and high-end clothes) to close the gap. Do not waste money early on things you will never use — the total is reachable through normal play. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property sites or signs — check the map for property icons you have not bought yet and save up the cash (robberies and laundered Marked Bills fund this). The exact number of garages is not pinned down in a published guide yet, so work through every garage icon on the map and let the trophy itself confirm the last one. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery/vehicle app. Open the app on the in-game phone, register vehicles you own or find (10 different ones), and the trophy pops at the tenth. If a vehicle will not register, try another model — the app likely only takes certain vehicle types, though no published guide lists which ones yet. Source: Exophase for the official name, description and grade; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.

roadmap.title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale (60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Play the story straight through. In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation after 'Down to Earth' (the one possibly missable trophy). Keep cheats OFF the whole run — PowerPyx reports cheats disable trophies (and saving). Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission: the game has no mission replay and no New Game Plus. Scan every new vehicle and study animals as you go — it all counts toward 100% later.

roadmap.title: Stranger missions — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone + 3 more strands
roadmap.text: Follow the question-mark icons and finish 8 full stranger strands. Some optional missions disappear as the story advances, but PowerPyx notes there are 200–300+ optional missions, far more than the game needs, so a vanished one never blocks a trophy.

roadmap.title: Activities and challenges
roadmap.text: Shooting Range golds, 20 different race wins, drone races at every location, 250 stunts, 50 challenges, fishing vs Cal, arcade, bowling, meditation spots, Combat Focus 5-kills, and the odd one-offs. Do the vague ones last — several have no confirmed method yet at launch.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and exploration
roadmap.text: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all of Leonida explored, every meditation spot with both characters. One map sweep covers all four if you WAiNK, scan and meditate as you travel.

roadmap.title: Crime and money
roadmap.text: 5 bank vaults, 1 armored truck, an illegal operation per gang, 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, 1 jewelry store undetected, $250,000 of Marked Bills laundered, $100,000 spent in shops, all garages bought, 10 vehicles on the Scooter Bros app.

roadmap.title: 100% cleanup and the Platinum
roadmap.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and finish the checklist — PowerPyx says the thresholds are lenient (about 60% of true completion): 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 shooting-range and racing challenges. 'A Long Road' (gold) pops, then the platinum 'Vice Got a Price!' follows automatically.

sourcesNote: Names, descriptions and grades: Exophase and PSNProfiles (agreeing on all 55). Roadmap, missable warning, difficulty (4/10), time (~200 hours), no mission replay, cheats disabling trophies, and the Chapter 1 meditation: PowerPyx. 100% checklist numbers (200/277 vehicles, 100/255 animals, 70/80 challenges): ComingSoon, reporting PowerPyx. Vague-trophy 'not yet known' status: PowerPyx via eGamers. All guides are this entry's own words; where a step is unconfirmed, the guide says so.
